verdict.rationale: Exporting user data such as chats, prompts and configurations is a fair question for a desktop chat app, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no export feature or open-format data portability. Model management, folders for organizing chats, and Hugging Face downloads are adjacent features, not data export.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
